Prealgebra · Lesson 8.3

Simplifying Square Roots

Solve this lesson →All lessons

In 8.2 you estimated 12≈3.512​≈3.5. This lesson rewrites it exactly. Since 12=4×312=4×3 has a perfect square factor, ab=abab​=a​b​ lets you pull 4=24​=2 out front, giving 2323​.

Problem
Compute 4×254​×25​ and compare it to 4×254×25​. Do they agree? What is 100100​?
Show a hint
  • A perfect square is a number whose root is whole. Ask what whole number times itself gives 100100.
  • Since 10×10=10010×10=100, the root of 100100 is 1010. Notice it matches 4×25=2×54​×25​=2×5.
Show the full solution
4×25=2×5=104​×25​=2×5=10, and 4×25=100=104×25​=100​=10, since 10×10=10010×10=100. Both routes give 1010​. Rooting a product and multiplying the roots always agree, and that is the rule the rest of this lesson runs on.
Key idea
Product rule. The square root of a product is the product of the roots, ab=a×bab​=a​×b​, for nonnegative aa and bb. So a root splits wherever its radicand factors. If one of those factors is a perfect square, its root comes out as a whole number while the rest stays under the radical, and that is how you simplify.
Problem
Simplify 1212​ using 12=4×312=4×3. Split into 4×34​×3​, then root the perfect-square piece. What whole number comes out in front of 33​?
Show a hint
  • Split 1212 as 4×34×3, so 12=4×312​=4​×3​. The 33​ part cannot be tidied, but 44​ can.
  • Since 4=24​=2, the root becomes 2×32×3​, written 2323​. The whole number in front is 22.
Show the full solution
Since 12=4×312=4×3, 12=4×3=23.12​=4​×3​=23​. The whole number in front is 22​. The 33 has no perfect-square factor, so it stays under the radical. Squaring back gives (23)2=4×3=12(23​)2=4×3=12.
Problem
Simplify 7272​. The largest perfect square dividing 7272 is 3636, since 72=36×272=36×2. What whole number appears in front of 22​?
Show a hint
  • Write 7272 as 36×236×2, so 72=36×272​=36​×2​.
  • Since 36=636​=6, the simplest form is 6262​. The number in front is 66.
Show the full solution
Since 72=36×272=36×2, 72=36×2=62.72​=36​×2​=62​. The whole number in front is 66​. The leftover 22 is square-free, so 6262​ is simplest, and (62)2=36×2=72(62​)2=36×2=72 confirms it.
Problem
Simplify 4848​. The largest perfect square dividing 4848 is 1616, since 48=16×348=16×3. What number remains under the radical?
Show a hint
  • Write 48=16×348=16×3, so 48=16×348​=16​×3​. Which piece stays under the root?
  • Since 16=416​=4, the simplest form is 4343​. The number left under the radical is 33.
Show the full solution
Since 48=16×348=16×3, 48=16×3=43.48​=16​×3​=43​. The number left under the radical is 33​. The 44 comes out front and the 33 stays put, because 33 has no perfect-square factor bigger than 11.
Problem
Simplify 9898​. Since 98=49×298=49×2, split the root. What whole number is in front of 22​?
Show a hint
  • The perfect squares to test are 4,9,16,25,36,494,9,16,25,36,49. Which one divides 9898? Try 4949.
  • Since 98=49×298=49×2, we get 98=49×2=7298​=49​×2​=72​. The number in front is 77.
Show the full solution
Since 98=49×298=49×2, 98=49×2=72.98​=49​×2​=72​. The whole number in front is 77​. To find that factor, run through the squares 4,9,16,25,36,494,9,16,25,36,49 and keep the largest one that divides the radicand.
Key idea
Simplifying. To simplify a square root, find the largest perfect-square factor of the radicand, take its root to pull a whole number out front, and leave the rest under the radical. The pulled-out number multiplies the leftover root, like 12=43=2312​=4​3​=23​, which means 22 times 33​. If you use a smaller square factor instead, you have to simplify again.
Problem
Factor 30=2×3×530=2×3×5. Every prime appears just once, so no repeated factor forms a perfect square. What is the largest perfect square dividing 3030?
Show a hint
  • A perfect square needs a repeated factor, like 2×22×2 or 3×33×3. In 30=2×3×530=2×3×5, is any factor repeated?
  • None of 4,9,16,254,9,16,25 divides 3030. The only perfect square that does is 11, so 3030​ is already in simplest form.
Show the full solution
Factor 30=2×3×530=2×3×5. Every prime shows up once, so there is no repeated prime to build a square from, and none of 44, 99, 1616, or 2525 divides 3030. The largest perfect-square factor is 11​. Pulling out 1=11​=1 changes nothing, so 3030​ is already in simplest form.
Key idea
Simplest form. The number under a radical is the radicand. A square root is in simplest form when its radicand has no perfect-square factor bigger than 11, since nothing more can be pulled out. To check, factor the radicand, since a square factor needs a repeated prime. So 3030​ is simplest, because 30=2×3×530=2×3×5 repeats no prime.
Fun fact
An irrational root was called a surd, from the Latin surdus (deaf or mute), since it cannot be spoken as a clean ratio. The bar drawn over the radicand is the vinculum, Latin for a bond.
Problem
Simplify 10×510​×5​. Combine under one radical to get 5050​. Then pull out the perfect-square factor. What whole number is in front of 22​?
Show a hint
  • Combine first, 10×5=5010​×5​=50​. Then look for the largest perfect square dividing 5050.
  • Since 50=25×250=25×2, we get 50=25×2=5250​=25​×2​=52​. The number in front is 55.
Show the full solution
Combine the roots, 10×5=5010​×5​=50​. The largest perfect square dividing 5050 is 2525, so 50=25×2=52.50​=25​×2​=52​. The whole number in front is 55​. Combining first often exposes a square factor that neither root showed on its own.
Problem
Simplify 507507​ to the form a3a3​. What is aa?
Show a hint
  • The number 507507 is odd, so 4,16,36,64,1004,16,36,64,100 cannot divide it. Try odd perfect squares like 99, 2525, 4949, 121121, 169169.
  • Since 507=169×3507=169×3 and 169=13169​=13, the simplest form is 133133​. The number in front is 1313.
Show the full solution
Since 507=169×3507=169×3 and 169=132169=132, 507=169×3=133,507​=169​×3​=133​, so a=13a=13​. Because 507507 is odd, only odd squares can divide it, which shortens the search to 9,25,49,121,1699,25,49,121,169.

Practice these ideas

Practice
Simplify 88​. The largest perfect square dividing 88 is 44, since 8=4×28=4×2. Written as a whole number times 22​, what is the whole number in front?
Show the solution
Since 8=4×28=4×2, 8=4×2=22.8​=4​×2​=22​. The whole number in front is 22​.
Practice
Simplify 7575​. Since 75=25×375=25×3 and 2525 is a perfect square, the root tidies into a whole number times 33​. What is the whole number in front?
Show the solution
Since 75=25×375=25×3, 75=25×3=53.75​=25​×3​=53​. The whole number in front is 55​.
Practice
Simplify 4444​. The largest perfect square dividing 4444 is 44, since 44=4×1144=4×11. What number is left under the radical?
Show the solution
Since 44=4×1144=4×11, 44=4×11=211.44​=4​×11​=211​. The 1111 is square-free and stays under the radical, so the number left under it is 1111​.
Practice
Simplify 128128​. The largest perfect square dividing 128128 is 6464, since 128=64×2128=64×2. Written as a whole number times 22​, what is the whole number in front?
Show the solution
Since 128=64×2128=64×2, 128=64×2=82.128​=64​×2​=82​. The whole number in front is 88​.
Practice
Combine 3×123​×12​ under one radical and evaluate. What whole number is the result?
Show the solution
Join the roots, 3×12=3×12=363​×12​=3×12​=36​. Since 3636 is a perfect square, 36=636​=6, a clean whole number. So the value is 66​.
Practice
Factor 60=2×2×3×560=2×2×3×5. The repeated prime forms a perfect square. What is the largest perfect square dividing 6060?
Show the solution
Factor 60=2×2×3×560=2×2×3×5. The only repeated prime is 22, giving the perfect square 2×2=42×2=4. No larger perfect square divides 6060, since 33 and 55 appear only once. So the largest perfect-square factor is 44​. (It would simplify 6060​ to 215215​.)
Practice
Decide whether 3333​ can be simplified. Factor 3333 completely, then find the largest perfect square that divides it. What is that largest perfect square?
Show the solution
Factor 33=3×1133=3×11. Each prime appears once, so there is no repeated factor to form a perfect square. The largest perfect square dividing 3333 is 11​, which means 3333​ is already in simplest form.
Practice
Combine 15×615​×6​ under one radical to get 9090​. Since 90=9×1090=9×10, simplify. What whole number appears in front of 1010​?
Show the solution
Join the roots, 15×6=15×6=9015​×6​=15×6​=90​. The largest perfect square dividing 9090 is 99, and 90=9×1090=9×10, so 90=9×10=310.90​=9​×10​=310​. The whole number in front is 33​.
Practice
Simplify 675675​. Since 675=225×3675=225×3 and 225=15225​=15, what whole number is in front of 33​?
Show the solution
Since 675=225×3675=225×3 and 225=152225=152, 675=225×3=153.675​=225​×3​=153​. The whole number in front is 1515​. Squaring back, (153)2=225×3=675(153​)2=225×3=675.
